methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $41M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 4 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Robotics & Manufacturing. Range: $1.1B - $2.0B.

data.narrative:
First Resonance is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $40.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer universe spanning 9 private companies and 1 public comparator across the robotics and manufacturing sector, with particular emphasis on 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage peers including Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Walden Robotics.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression methodology, anchoring to the $41M total raised as a proxy for current value, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implying a valuation of $82M. Peer-median analysis across the 4-company comparable set yields a median valuation of $1.7B, with a range spanning $1.1B (Walden Robotics, seed-stage) to $2.0B (Generalist AI, Series B). The dispersion reflects stage variance within the peer cohort, with three Series B companies trading at $1.6B–$2.0B and one seed-stage company at $1.1B.

Triangulation of both methods produces a range from $69M to $2.0B, with a median of $891M. The wide spread reflects material tension between stage-progression mechanics, which imply modest forward valuation from raised capital, and peer comparables, which suggest substantially higher market valuations for similar-sector companies. Key uncertainties include stage-specific comparability (First Resonance is earlier than most peers) and whether peer multiples reflect durable market conditions or transient valuations in a volatile sector.
